text:
Priya Desai: Heads up — I opened a docs PR for the tiered metering page. It updates the dashboard screenshots and replaces the old SDK snippet with the new v2 client. https://github.com/redwoodinference/docs/pull/842 :eyes:
Jordan Kim: thanks — can you call out the behavior for burst credits in the note? folks keep asking if they stack with reserved tiers.
Priya Desai: will add a small callout. thinking: short paragraph + an example table, and a tiny code sample showing the header.
Sam Ortiz: quick FYI — the v2 snippet needs the new header name X-RW-Metering-Context, not X-Metering. also the client example should use .withQuota() chain.
Priya Desai: good catch. I left the old header in one example, fixing now.
Alex M.: also re: dashboard panels — the screenshot uses the renamed metric `billing.requests_per_tier` but the panel query in the snippet uses `billing.requests_by_tier`. please align.
Priya Desai: ack, I'll update the query and attach a fresh screenshot.
docs-bot: PR 842 updated by priya — changed snippet header; CI docs-linter passed. https://github.com/redwoodinference/docs/commit/9f3b2a
Jordan Kim: can we add a one-line migration note for Dedicated customers? they might still be on the old SDK. Suggest: "If you're on Dedicated and haven't upgraded the agent, continue to use X-Metering until agent v3.2+"
Priya Desai: added that note under "Migration notes". kept it short and linked to the agent release notes.
Sam Ortiz: unit test for the snippet render would be nice — small script to validate the example runs with the v2 client (no network). I can push a tiny fixture.
Priya Desai: that'd be great. if you add it as a follow-up commit, I'll re-run the linter and verify the snippet preview in Netlify.
Alex M.: small nit — can we use single backticks for inline CLI examples and fenced block for full config? reviewers keep flagging inconsistent formatting.
Priya Desai: fixed formatting across the page.
Jordan Kim: LGTM from docs side. once Sam adds the fixture and you update screenshots, merge. :thumbsup:
Sam Ortiz: pushing a test fixture in a sec — will ping when ready.
Priya Desai: thanks all — merging after test arrives. I'll add a quick internal note in #eng-runtime about the header rename so nodes don't surprise support.
Jordan Kim: good call.
Sam Ortiz: test pushed, thread in PR. https://github.com/redwoodinference/docs/pull/842/files#diff-22
Priya Desai: merged — thanks everyone. follow-ups: update changelog and notify customer-success about the wording change. :tada:
